name: Azilal
hero_subtitle: Gateway to the High Atlas — thundering falls, Ait Bouguemez Happy Valley, mountain lakes and dinosaur tracks.

overview.title: Welcome to Azilal — High Atlas nature, waterfalls and historic valleys
overview.p1: Azilal sits in the central High Atlas of Morocco, with deep gorges, snow-capped peaks, terraced valleys and UNESCO-recognised geological wonders.
overview.p2: It is home to the world-famous Ouzoud Waterfalls, Ait Bouguemez (Happy Valley), turquoise Bin el Ouidane Lake and fossil dinosaur tracks — ideal for nature and adventure travellers.

places.title: Must-see places in Azilal
places.subtitle: Majestic falls, pristine mountain valleys and ancient geological sites.

ouzoud.title: Ouzoud Waterfalls
ouzoud.desc: Morocco's finest cascade at 110 m, rainbow pools and Barbary macaques.

bouguemez.title: Ait Bouguemez (Happy Valley)
bouguemez.desc: Lush valley of Amazigh villages, apple orchards and classic hiking trails.

binelouidane.title: Bin el Ouidane Lake
binelouidane.desc: Striking turquoise reservoir framed by red cliffs — boating and relaxation.

dinosaurs.title: Iouaridene dinosaur footprints
dinosaurs.desc: Preserved sauropod tracks in High Atlas rock layers.

demnate.title: Imi n'Ifri natural bridge
demnate.desc: Spectacular natural rock bridge near Demnate carved by water.

cathedral.title: Cathedral Rock (Anrgui)
cathedral.desc: Massive rock formation like a mountain cathedral above the gorge.

museum.title: M'Goun Geopark Museum
museum.desc: Modern museum in Azilal town with dinosaurs, fossils and Atlas history.

zaouia.title: Zaouia Ahansal
zaouia.desc: Historic spiritual sanctuary and stone granaries in remote gorges.

stays.title: Where to stay in Azilal and the Atlas
stays.subtitle: From mountain guesthouses in Ait Bouguemez to lakeside resorts and falls lodges.

card1.name: Hotel Chems Le Lac
card1.desc: Resort hotel overlooking turquoise Bin el Ouidane with outdoor pool and water activities.

card2.name: Dar Itrane (Bouguemez)
card2.desc: Eco-lodge in the Happy Valley with Amazigh hospitality, home cooking and mountain guides.

card3.name: Riad Cascade Ouzoud
card3.desc: Quiet guesthouse minutes from Ouzoud Falls with garden and mountain views.

card4.name: Hotel Azilal Center
card4.desc: Comfortable town hotel for exploring the geopark museum and mountain routes.

booking_banner.title: Explore all stays in Azilal & Ouzoud
booking_banner.desc: Compare real-time rates, read verified reviews and enjoy free cancellation on most guesthouses and hotels.

eat.title: Where to eat in Azilal & Ouzoud
eat.subtitle: Terrace restaurants by the falls, Amazigh tagines and honey tasting.

ouzoud.title: Falls viewpoint terraces
ouzoud.desc: Riverside tagines and fresh orange juice with cascade views.

bouguemez.title: Mountain guesthouse meals
bouguemez.desc: Handmade couscous, garden vegetables and Amazigh bread from clay ovens.

lakeside.title: Lakeside restaurants
lakeside.desc: Grills and lake fish on sunny terraces overlooking the reservoir.

tips.title: Practical tips for Azilal and the High Atlas

transport.title: Getting around
transport.desc: Renting a 4x4 or car from Marrakech is best for mountain passes, Ouzoud and Ait Bouguemez roads.

bargain.title: Mountain weather
bargain.desc: High Atlas weather changes fast. Even in spring, nights are chilly — pack warm layers and sturdy boots.

water.title: Guides & culture
water.desc: A local mountain guide in Ait Bouguemez enriches hikes; carry cash as ATMs are scarce in remote valleys.

daytrips.title: Best day trips from Azilal
daytrips.subtitle: Surrounding gorges, lakes and imperial cities.

marrakech.title: Marrakech (2.5 hrs)
marrakech.desc: Connect easily to the medina and palaces of Marrakech.

benimellal.title: Beni Mellal & Ain Asserdoune (1 hr)
benimellal.desc: Historic spring garden and fortress over the Tadla plain.

imilchil.title: Imilchil Lakes (scenic drive)
imilchil.desc: Drive high plateaus to the twin lakes of Isli and Tislit.

q1.question: How many days in Azilal?
q1.answer: Three to four days are ideal for Ouzoud, Ait Bouguemez and Bin el Ouidane.

q2.question: Best time for Ait Bouguemez?
q2.answer: Spring (April–June) and autumn (September–November) offer ideal hiking weather and green valleys.

q3.question: Can I see dinosaur footprints?
q3.answer: Yes — Azilal is part of the M'Goun UNESCO Global Geopark, with sauropod tracks at Iouaridene and a museum in town.

q4.question: How do I get to Azilal?
q4.answer: By road in about 2.5 hours from Marrakech or 1 hour from Beni Mellal on paved national roads.

itinerary.title: Suggested 3-day plan for Azilal and the High Atlas
itinerary.subtitle: Falls first, then Happy Valley and dinosaur heritage.

detailed_itinerary.day1_md: Arrive from Marrakech or Beni Mellal; walk to the base of the 110 m falls and watch the macaques.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ad: Drive to Azilal town and visit the M'Goun Geopark Museum for fossils and regional history.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ed: Check into a traditional guesthouse or mountain hotel for a warm Amazigh tagine dinner.
detailed_itinerary.day2_md: Scenic mountain drive into the Happy Valley.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ad: Explore terraced fields, adobe granaries and meet local villagers.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ed: Overnight in an authentic mountain lodge under High Atlas peaks.
detailed_itinerary.day3_md: Discover sauropod tracks preserved in mountain rock.
detailed_itinerary.day3_ad: Relax by turquoise waters, boat ride or panoramic lunch.
detailed_itinerary.day3_ed: Last Atlas views before returning to Marrakech or Beni Mellal.
